{{Quote|Good morning, Governor. How was the trip this morning?''"<br />"''Pretty quiet for this time of year. That's on the agenda for this morning, Revan?|Revan greets the governor|<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>}}
A '''governor''' was so disliked by the population that they had to use a [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo.]] [[SCS-19 Sentinel/Legends|SCS-19 Sentinel]] to get to work. The trip in usually forced the governor to deal with [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]], armed mobs, and strategically placed [[vibro-mine]]s. The governor had an aide called [[Revan (aide)|Revan]].<ref name="GFT" />
